description: A plain object `{ type, payload }` describing something that happened. Created by action creators such as `todoAdded('x')`.
A pure function `(state, action) => nextState`. In RTK case reducers can mutate an Immer draft instead.
Generates action creators, action types and a reducer from a `name`, `initialState` and `reducers` map. Optional `selectors` are wrapped to read from the root state.
Customizes the action payload inside the action creator, the right place for ids and timestamps.
Creates the store with good defaults: combined reducers, thunk middleware, DevTools and development checks for mutations and non-serializable values.
react-redux hooks to read a selected value (re-rendering when it changes) and to dispatch actions.
Data fetching and caching layer built into Redux Toolkit (`createApi`), an alternative to TanStack Query for server state.
